hooks.command: F=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'')}catch(e){}})"); case "$F" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro) OUT=$(npx eslint --fix "$F" 2>&1); CODE=$?; if [ $CODE -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUT"; exit 2; fi ;; esac

F=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'')}catch(e){}})"); case "$F" in *.ts|*.tsx) OUT=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1); CODE=$?; if [ $CODE -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUT"; exit 2; fi ;; esac
